name: glare-card
title: Glare Card
blurb: Card with pointer-tracked rainbow gradient glare and 3D tilt effect.
description: A 3D card that rotates and tilts toward the pointer, with a rainbow gradient and SVG foil pattern that shift position. Glare intensity and background position follow mouse movement.
use_when: High-impact hero sections, product showcases, or interactive galleries where tactile 3D feedback and rainbow aesthetics…
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces, low-motion accessibility contexts, or content-dense layouts where 3D effects could distract.
a11y: Card is a container for children; 3D effects are visual embellishment. No prefers-reduced-motion guard; rainbow gradients and rotation always apply.
